item.statement: The kernel has no direct status return; launch and execution errors are observed by the host caller, and odata must not be used as an in-band status channel.

plans.objective: Verify the candidate error-status model matches the no-in-band-status contract.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the entry point and host error paths.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the kernel returns void or Ascend-C equivalent, failures are propagated host-side, and no odata element encodes error or success status.
plans.setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate kernel return type, host wrapper error propagation, and any odata status convention.
